findings.title: Command not found in the image
findings.cause: container web runs "webserver --port 8080", which is not in image docker.io/library/busybox:1.37.0@sha256:a7dbc319b1438115a207e11930dc4bb3e643dcb3ec0bdd694bb36cd8fad289ec; Deployment web has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.detail: failed to create containerd task: failed to create shim task: OCI runtime create failed: runc create failed: unable to start container process: error during container init: exec: "webserver": executable file not found in $PATH

findings.fix: Correct the command (or the image's entrypoint): use a path that exists in the image.
